description: This file declares the SetVolume class, which is a task for setting the volume in a media player context within the Rialto server's generic tasks namespace. It includes class members for context, a wrapper for GStreamer operations, and the volume level.

classes.name: SetVolume
classes.description: A class representing a task to set the volume in the media player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with the player context, GStreamer wrapper, and desired volume.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to set the volume using the provided context and GStreamer wrapper.
